instructions: id-jag-check is a GitHub Action that checks the ID-JAGs an IdP issues against draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant-06, using better-auth-id-jag's rules. dist/ is the esbuild bundle of src/, and CI checks that it matches, so review src/. Put security and correctness first, above all what the Action sends and what it prints to the log, the job summary and the outputs. When a comment is about protocol behaviour, name the section of the draft or the RFC it rests on.
